title: Meta Build Systems as Logic Programs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Meta build systems such as CMake, Meson and Bazel derive command graphs from project descriptions, user choices and machine facts. Imperative scripts, search paths and special cases make routine decisions interact poorly: search order can choose compatible packages without an explicit project choice, packagers must patch author flag preferences, and cross-builds need annotations or nested build trees for tools run during the build.   Our central insight is to express configuration as relational inference: objects follow from sources, flags and libraries from dependencies, and language standards from transitive requirements. We introduce buildlog, a meta build system whose stratified logical core isolates build derivation from impure environmental probes. It rejects ambiguity in toolchain or package selection and explains derived facts through provenance. Author constraints and user preferences use distinct, statically checked input rel

translated_title: 作为逻辑程序的元构建系统
translated_abstract: 诸如 CMake、Meson 和 Bazel 等元构建系统从项目描述、用户选择和机器事实中推导出命令图。命令式脚本、搜索路径和特殊情况使得常规决策之间交互不佳：搜索顺序可以在没有明确项目选择的情况下选择兼容的软件包，打包人员必须修补作者的编译标志偏好，而交叉构建则需要注释或嵌套构建树来支持构建期间运行的工具。我们的核心洞察是将配置表达为关系推理：目标文件源于源代码，编译标志和库源于依赖关系，语言标准源于传递性需求。我们介绍了 buildlog，一个元构建系统，其分层的逻辑核心将构建推导与非纯的环境探测隔离开来。它拒绝工具链或软件包选择中的歧义，并通过溯源来解释推导出的事实。作者约束和用户偏好使用不同的、经过静态检查的输入关系……
tldr: 该论文提出将构建配置表达为关系推理，并介绍了 buildlog 这一元构建系统，其分层逻辑核心将构建推导与环境探测隔离，拒绝工具链和软件包选择中的歧义，并通过溯源解释推导结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes expressing build configuration as relational inference and introduces buildlog, a meta build system whose stratified logical core isolates build derivation from impure environmental probes, rejects ambiguity in toolchain and package selection, and explains derived facts through provenance.
